components.name: Grain gradient
components.description: Grain gradient — slowly drifting soft colour blobs under a fine grain (2.6 Backgrounds). Decorative only (BGR-01). Tone Neutral (fill/soft-* + accent/soft) / Brand (gradient/brand-* + accent). Intensity = blob opacity (.35 · .6 · .9) + grain amount. Grain is a Figma Noise effect (colour not bindable — exception noted in 2.6 doc). React: <GrainGradient tone intensity speed grain blobs />.

Grain gradient.text:
ASSETS · BACKGROUNDS
BEK
Design System
2.6 Backgrounds · Grain gradient
Soft colour blobs drifting slowly under a fine grain. No pointer effect — the calmest background for long reading pages and covers.
Overview
Two tones × three intensities (6 variants).
Neutral
fill/soft-pressed, accent/soft, fill/strong and a touch of accent/default.
Brand
gradient/brand-start, gradient/brand-end, accent/default, brand/logo-solid — the BEK violet → blue.
Anatomy
Base
bg/base
Blobs
Four blurred ellipses (blur 110), colours from tokens
Drift
In code blobs move on slow loops (20–40 s)
Grain
Figma Noise effect (multitone, size 1.2); in code an SVG feTurbulence overlay
Intensity
Preset strength. In code every value is a prop; presets are starting points.
Subtle
blob opacity .35 · grain .18.
Default
blob opacity .6 · grain .28.
Intense
blob opacity .9 · grain .40 — covers only.
Usage
Rules BGR-01 … BGR-06 (see Matrix rain) apply to every background on this page.
• Good behind large headlines: no high-frequency detail competes with text.
• Grain hides banding on wide gradients — keep it on.
• Exception: the Noise effect colour cannot be bound to a token in Figma (fixed black, opacity per intensity).
Devices
Instances resize freely — content scales, edges clip. Keep text in a calm area (BGR-02).
